query: What is Lovable's most recently reported number of users, and its most recently reported number of full-time employees? Give each figure with its reporting period and the primary source.
report: Lovable’s most recently reported number of users is “8 million users,” reported by CEO Anton Osika to TechCrunch in November 2025 (period: “as of Nov 2025”) [1]. Lovable’s most recently reported number of full-time employees is 146 full-time employees, reported by chief revenue officer Ryan Meadows to TechCrunch in March 2026 as the headcount at the time of Lovable’s $400M ARR milestone in February 2026 (period: Feb 2026; reported in Mar 2026) [2].
